style: 既存の彩色会話人物画に合わせた透過画。配膳係と患者の具体的な外見・年齢感・服装は美術設定。配膳係の女性としての描画も本文の確定設定にはしない。患者の性別・病名を追加せず、顔全体を布で覆う姿を保つ。皿・食事・配膳口・修理・公開範囲を共通人物画へ固定しない。

files.prompt_en: Create one isolated standing character asset for a Japanese dungeon adventure game, a single adult meal attendant. Vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, genuine transparent background. Hand-painted character illustration with fine cloth texture, precise facial features, softly modeled form, warm restrained colors, and a clean readable silhouette. Show the complete head and body down to below the knees, centered, viewed slightly from the front, with generous transparent margins. The head occupies the upper fifth of the canvas. A woman with a broad oval face, short loosely curling chestnut hair gathered away from the cheeks, brown eyes, and a composed attentive expression. She wears a plain muted sage-green work dress with rolled sleeves, a clean cream linen apron tied at the waist, and a simple dark brown belt. Her shoulders are relaxed. Both empty hands are visible at waist level, one palm gently turned upward as she explains a delivery, the other relaxed beside the apron. Natural hand anatomy with five fingers on each hand. Subtle wear on cloth, softly lit from the upper left. Clothing and appearance are visual design choices for this unnamed role. Only this one character. No plate, food, tray, tools, furniture, walls, floor, setting, lettering, symbols, frame, cast ground shadow, or watermark.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語の迷宮冒険ゲーム用に、配膳係の成人1人を切り抜いた立ち絵を作成する。縦1024×1536、本当の透過背景。細かな布地、明瞭な顔立ち、柔らかな立体感、落ち着いた暖色、見分けやすい輪郭を備えた手描きの人物画。頭全体から膝下までを中央に収め、正面から少し斜め向きとし、周囲に十分な透明余白を取る。頭は画面上部5分の1に置く。幅のある卵形の顔、頬から離してまとめた短い栗色の緩い巻き毛、茶色の目、落ち着いて注意を向ける表情の女性。くすんだセージグリーンの無地の作業着は袖をまくり、清潔なクリーム色の麻の前掛けを腰で結び、簡素な焦げ茶色のベルトを着ける。肩は力を抜く。空の両手を腰の高さに見せ、片手の掌を穏やかに上へ向けて配達について説明し、もう片手は前掛けの脇で自然に下げる。左右とも指が5本ある自然な手。布にはわずかな使い込みを付け、左上から柔らかく照らす。服装と外見はこの匿名の役の美術設定。人物は1人だけ。皿、食事、盆、道具、家具、壁、床、周囲の情景、文字、記号、枠、地面への落ち影、透かしを含めない。

files.prompt_en: Create one isolated standing character asset for a Japanese dungeon adventure game, a single adult patient of unspecified gender who deliberately keeps their entire face hidden. Vertical 1024 by 1536 canvas, genuine transparent background. Hand-painted character illustration with fine cloth texture, softly modeled form, warm restrained colors, and a clean readable silhouette. Show the complete head and body down to below the knees, centered, facing forward, with generous transparent margins. The head occupies the upper fifth of the canvas. The person holds a plain opaque warm-gray linen cloth across the whole face with both hands. The cloth covers the brow, eyes, nose, mouth, chin, and both cheeks without gaps; no facial features are visible. A little short dark hair is visible only above the cloth. Fingers hold the outer edges near the temples, leaving the cloth continuous across the face. Shoulders are gently rounded and the head is slightly lowered in a quiet, self-possessed posture. The person wears a loose unadorned slate-blue long gown with long sleeves and a muted tan shoulder wrap. Both forearms and natural hands are clear. Soft light from the upper left and subtle fabric folds. Appearance and clothing are visual design choices, without depicting a specific diagnosis. Only this one character. No plate, food, tray, medical devices, injuries, furniture, walls, floor, setting, lettering, symbols, frame, cast ground shadow, or watermark.
files.prompt_ja: 日本語の迷宮冒険ゲーム用に、自分の顔全体を意図して隠す、性別を限定しない成人患者1人を切り抜いた立ち絵を作成する。縦1024×1536、本当の透過背景。細かな布地、柔らかな立体感、落ち着いた暖色、見分けやすい輪郭を備えた手描きの人物画。頭全体から膝下までを中央に収め、正面を向き、周囲に十分な透明余白を取る。頭は画面上部5分の1に置く。両手で無地の不透明な暖かい灰色の麻布を顔全体に当てる。布は額、目、鼻、口、顎、両頬を隙間なく覆い、顔のパーツは見えない。布の上に短い濃色の髪だけが少し見える。指はこめかみ近くで布の外側の端を持ち、顔の前は途切れない一枚の布にする。肩を穏やかに丸め、頭を少し下げた、静かで自分の意思を保つ姿。ゆったりした装飾のないスレートブルーの長袖の長衣に、落ち着いた黄褐色の肩掛けを着ける。両前腕と自然な手が分かるようにする。左上からの柔らかい光と控えめな布の襞。外見と服装は美術設定であり、特定の病気を描かない。人物は1人だけ。皿、食事、盆、医療器具、傷、家具、壁、床、周囲の情景、文字、記号、枠、地面への落ち影、透かしを含めない。
